title: Unique Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct value in an array has a unique occurrence count.

title: Unique Number of Occurrences
statement: Return true if every distinct value in an array has a unique occurrence count.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean uniqueOccurrences(int[] arr){Map<Integer,Integer>c=new HashMap<>();for(int x:arr)c.put(x,c.getOrDefault(x,0)+1);return new HashSet<>(c.values()).size()==c.size();} }

title: Minimum Cost to Move Chips to The Same Position
statement: Return the minimum cost to move all chips to one position when moving by two costs zero and moving by one costs one.

title: Minimum Cost to Move Chips to The Same Position
statement: Return the minimum cost to move all chips to one position when moving by two costs zero and moving by one costs one.
code: class Solution { public int minCostToMoveChips(int[] position){int even=0;for(int x:position)if(x%2==0)even++;return Math.min(even,position.length-even);} }

statement: Split a balanced string into the maximum number of balanced substrings, each containing equal L and R characters.

title: Check If It Is a Straight Line
statement: Return true if all coordinate points lie on one straight line.
code: class Solution { public boolean checkStraightLine(int[][] c){int x0=c[0][0],y0=c[0][1],x1=c[1][0],y1=c[1][1];for(int i=2;i<c.length;i++)if((c[i][0]-x0)*(y1-y0)!=(c[i][1]-y0)*(x1-x0))return false;return true;} }

title: Cells with Odd Values in a Matrix
statement: Starting with a zero matrix, increment every cell in each selected row and column and count cells with odd values.

title: Cells with Odd Values in a Matrix
statement: Starting with a zero matrix, increment every cell in each selected row and column and count cells with odd values.
code: class Solution { public int oddCells(int m,int n,int[][] indices){int[]r=new int[m],c=new int[n];for(int[]x:indices){r[x[0]]++;c[x[1]]++;}int ans=0;for(int i=0;i<m;i++)for(int j=0;j<n;j++)if((r[i]+c[j])%2==1)ans++;return ans;} }

title: Shift 2D Grid
statement: Shift every grid cell k positions right in row-major order, wrapping around at the end.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<List<Integer>> shiftGrid(int[][] grid,int k){int m=grid.length,n=grid[0].length,total=m*n;k%=total;List<Integer>a=new ArrayList<>();for(int[]row:grid)for(int x:row)a.add(x);List<List<Integer>>out=new ArrayList<>();for(int r=0;r<m;r++){List<Integer>row=new ArrayList<>();for(int c=0;c<n;c++){int idx=(r*n+c-k+total)%total;row.add(a.get(idx));}out.add(row);}return out;} }

title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
statement: Return the minimum time to visit points in order when diagonal, horizontal, and vertical moves each take one second.

title: Minimum Time Visiting All Points
statement: Return the minimum time to visit points in order when diagonal, horizontal, and vertical moves each take one second.
code: class Solution { public int minTimeToVisitAllPoints(int[][] points){int ans=0;for(int i=1;i<points.length;i++)ans+=Math.max(Math.abs(points[i][0]-points[i-1][0]),Math.abs(points[i][1]-points[i-1][1]));return ans;} }

title: Find Winner on a Tic Tac Toe Game
statement: Return A, B, Draw, or Pending for a valid sequence of tic-tac-toe moves.

title: Find Winner on a Tic Tac Toe Game
statement: Return A, B, Draw, or Pending for a valid sequence of tic-tac-toe moves.
code: class Solution { public String tictactoe(int[][] moves){char[][]b=new char[3][3];for(int i=0;i<moves.length;i++){int r=moves[i][0],c=moves[i][1];char p=i%2==0?'A':'B';b[r][c]=p;boolean win=true;for(int j=0;j<3;j++)if(b[r][j]!=p)win=false;if(win)return String.valueOf(p);win=true;for(int j=0;j<3;j++)if(b[j][c]!=p)win=false;if(win)return String.valueOf(p);if(r==c){win=true;for(int j=0;j<3;j++)if(b[j][j]!=p)win=false;if(win)return String.valueOf(p);}if(r+c==2){win=true;for(int j=0;j<3;j++)if(b[j][2-j]!=p)win=false;if(win)return String.valueOf(p);}}return moves.length==9?"Draw":"Pending";} }

title: Subtract the Product and Sum of Digits of an Integer
statement: Return the product of the digits minus their sum.

title: Subtract the Product and Sum of Digits of an Integer
statement: Return the product of the digits minus their sum.
code: class Solution { public int subtractProductAndSum(int n){int prod=1,sum=0;while(n>0){int d=n%10;prod*=d;sum+=d;n/=10;}return prod-sum;} }

title: Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits
statement: Return how many integers in the array have an even number of decimal digits.

title: Find Numbers with Even Number of Digits
statement: Return how many integers in the array have an even number of decimal digits.
code: class Solution { public int findNumbers(int[] nums){int ans=0;for(int x:nums){int d=0;while(x>0){x/=10;d++;}if(d%2==0)ans++;}return ans;} }
